'''Xiaohan''' ({{zh|s=小寒|p=Xiǎo Hán}}) is a [[Singapore]]an female Chinese pop music lyricist.

==Biography==
She published her first lyrical work ('義無反顧' performed by 阮丹青) in 1998.{{citation needed|date=June 2012}} Ever since 2000, where she earned a nomination spot in the Singapore Hit Awards with '你抽的煙', Xiaohan has been a consistent nominee in the annual event.{{citation needed|date=June 2012}} She became the first female to be crowned Best Local Lyricist at the Singapore Hit Awards 2002 with '紙飛機'.<ref name="Xiaohan5">Xin Msn Yes 93.3FM, "[http://entertainment.xin.msn.com/zh/radio/SHA-2011/past-winners.aspx?cp-documentid=5245108 Past Winners of Singapore Hit Awards] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131206180644/http://entertainment.xin.msn.com/zh/radio/SHA-2011/past-winners.aspx?cp-documentid=5245108 |date=6 December 2013 }}", 7 June 2012</ref>{{unreliable source?|date=June 2012}} Xiaohan reclaimed the title again in 2004, with '無底洞'.<ref name="Xiaohan5" />{{unreliable source?|date=June 2012}} She held on to the title in 2007, 2008 and 2010 with '雨天' (Performed by [[Stefanie Sun]]), '達爾文' and '抛物綫' (Both performed by [[Tanya Chua]]) respectively.{{unreliable source?|date=June 2012}}<ref name="Xiaohan5" /> In addition to the Singapore Hit Awards, Xiaohan's lyrical works were also recognised in Singapore Compass Awards as well as Singapore eAwards.<ref name="Xiaohan14">COMPASS, Published on 10 July 2011, "[http://www.compass.org.sg/cIndex336.aspx 16TH COMPASS AWARDS PRESENTATION – LIST OF RECIPIENTS] {{Webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20121225101001/http://www.compass.org.sg/cIndex336.aspx |date=25 December 2012 }}", 8 June 2012</ref> '達爾文' garnered Xiaohan her first regional Best Lyricist nomination in Taiwan's [[Golden Melody Awards]] in 2008.<ref name="Xiaohan15">The Straits Times, Published on 24 May 2008, "[http://www.asiaone.com/News/The%2BStraits%2BTimes/Story/A1Story20080524-66741.html Trio vying for Taiwan awards]", 8 June 2012</ref>

From the Chinese pop music scene, Xiaohan expanded her scope to penning lyrics for musicals.{{unreliable source?|date=June 2012}}<ref name="Xiaohan16">The Theatre Practice, "[http://www.liaozhairocks.com/?page_id=25 Creators of Liao Zhai Rocks] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131211194228/http://www.liaozhairocks.com/?page_id=25 |date=11 December 2013 }}", 8 June 2012</ref> She was also involved in the [[Speak Mandarin Campaign]] 2006, a fund-raising album "Hands United" for the [[2004 tsunami]] victims and being a judge in various competitions.<ref name="Xiaohan19">Promote Mandarin Council, Published on 30 October 2006, "[http://www.mandarin.org.sg/?p=894&lang=zh-hans Speak Mandarin Campaign Celebrates with Movies, Music and Metaphors]", 8 June 2012</ref>

She is currently the co-director of Funkie Monkies Productions with Eric Ng.<ref name="Xiaohan22">Funkie Monkies, "[http://www.fmpopmusicschool.com.sg/Funkie_Monkies/about.html About Funkie Monkies] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120718043059/http://www.fmpopmusicschool.com.sg/Funkie_Monkies/about.html |date=18 July 2012 }}, 7 June 2012</ref>
With the collaboration of Funkie Monkies Productions with Royston Tan, Xiaohan participated in the making of the soundtracks for Royston Tan's blockbusters, "881" and "12蓮花".<ref name="Xiaohan25">Sinema, Published on 20 October 2007, "[http://www.sinema.sg/2007/10/20/interviews-eric-ng-on-881-soundtrack-2/ Eric Ng on 881 Soundtrack 2]", 7 June 2012</ref>{{unreliable source?|date=June 2012}}  In 2008 and 2009, Xiaohan had the honour of penning the mandarin version of the Singapore National Day theme song, titled '晴空萬里' (performed by [[Joi Chua]]) and '就在這裡' (performed by [[Kelvin Tan]]) respectively.<ref name="Xiaohan27">People's Association-Culture Shiok, Published in September 2010, "[http://www.cultureshiok.pa.gov.sg/features/sep-2010-feature-xiao-hans-lyrical-world-of-words/ Sep 2010 Feature – Xiao Han’s lyrical `World of Words’!]{{dead link|date=July 2016 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}", 8 June 2012</ref>{{citation needed|date=June 2012}}
